title: Final Persistence Red Team

test_results.note: Run with isolated elevated basetemp because sandboxed Windows temp creation hit permission errors.

notes: Attack 8 initially failed due a harness-generated duplicate cleanup repo_id. The corrected cleanup probe passed and is recorded here as PASS.
History poisoning was tested adversarially with a recomputed deterministic integrity_hash because the hash is not keyed or secret.
Memory mismatch was tested with both mismatched scan_id and same-scan text tampering. The mismatch subcase passed; same-scan text tampering failed.

attacks.name: 181C-01 wrong repo restore
attacks.setup: Scanned repo A, closed state, replaced the same path with repo B.
attacks.expected: Refuse or stale-mark restore; no repo A export for repo B.

attacks.name: 181C-02 file changed after restore
attacks.setup: Scanned repo, closed state, edited a scanned file, restarted restore path.
attacks.expected: stale_scan or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181C-03 git branch switch
attacks.setup: Scanned repo with git metadata, changed HEAD/ref, restarted restore path.
attacks.expected: stale_git_head_changed or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181C-04 plan history stale export
attacks.setup: Generated Change Plan, edited files, restarted, opened old plan history.
attacks.expected: Old plan copy/export blocked until refresh.

actual.stale_reason: Atlas needs a refresh before exporting context. The repository changed after this plan was generated.

attacks.name: 181C-05 history poisoning
attacks.setup: Appended forged JSONL history rows with fake files_named, secret-like text, and recomputed deterministic integrity_hash.
attacks.expected: Poisoned history rejected, sanitized, or untrusted; no poisoned history export.

actual.root_cause: History integrity hash is deterministic and can be recomputed after local JSONL tampering.

attacks.name: 181C-06 memory / scan mismatch
attacks.setup: Tampered persisted memory_packet.json.
attacks.expected: Mismatched or poisoned persisted memory is discarded; no export.

actual.root_cause: Session memory packet validation checks repo_id, scan_id, and signatures but does not authenticate the packet text.

attacks.name: 181C-07 version mismatch
attacks.setup: Changed latest.json atlas_version to 999.0.0-future-incompatible.
attacks.expected: Future or incompatible persistence version refused.

attacks.name: 181C-08 cleanup safety
attacks.setup: Created 12 fake scans and malformed/oversized history data, then ran cleanup.
attacks.expected: Cleanup keeps newest scan/history and survives malformed files.

attacks.name: 181C-09 support bundle
attacks.setup: Generated logs/history with api_key, Bearer, JWT, absolute path, and source-like markers.
attacks.expected: No raw source, secrets, absolute paths, or history content in support bundle.

attacks.name: 181C-10 concurrent restore and scan
attacks.setup: Persisted repo A, reset state, concurrently restored repo A, scanned repo B, and exported.
attacks.expected: No mixed old/new state during concurrent restore, scan, and export.

attacks.name: 181F-01 corrupted scan JSON
attacks.setup: Corrupted latest.json after a valid scan.
attacks.expected: Corrupt scan JSON does not restore or export stale context.

actual.resume_error: No saved scan for this repository.

attacks.name: 181F-02 corrupted history JSONL
attacks.setup: Prepended malformed JSON to a valid build history JSONL file.
attacks.expected: Malformed history lines ignored without poisoned export or crash.

attacks.name: 181F-03 deleted graph file
attacks.setup: Deleted graph.json after a valid scan.
attacks.expected: Incomplete scan sidecar refuses restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-04 deleted memory file
attacks.setup: Deleted memory_packet.json and the repository memory file after a valid scan.
attacks.expected: Deleted memory does not export mismatched or poisoned memory.

attacks.name: 181F-05 partial write file
attacks.setup: Left poisoned latest.json.tmp beside a valid latest.json.
attacks.expected: Leftover partial write file ignored; no poison export.

attacks.name: 181F-06 repo renamed
attacks.setup: Scanned repo, then renamed the repository folder.
attacks.expected: Renamed or missing repo path refuses restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-07 repo replaced at same path
attacks.setup: Scanned repo A, deleted it, recreated repo B at the same path.
attacks.expected: Same-path replacement marks stale; no wrong-repo restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-08 branch switch
attacks.setup: Scanned repo with git metadata, changed HEAD/ref, restarted restore path.
attacks.expected: Branch switch marks stale or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181F-09 fake scan_id
attacks.setup: Changed latest.json scan_id and memory_ref to a fake value after scan.
attacks.expected: Fake scan_id cannot produce mismatched memory export.

attacks.name: 181F-10 concurrent restore + scan + export
attacks.setup: Persisted repo A, reset state, concurrently restored repo A, scanned repo B, and exported repeatedly.
attacks.expected: No mixed old/new state.
